## Checklist

- [ ] Link works, and the repository contains an actual implementation
      (not only manifests, registry files, and a logo)
- [ ] Codex-specific, or an MCP server — not a generic AI tool that lists Codex
      in a feature matrix
- [ ] Committed to within the last ~6 months, or it is official documentation
- [ ] Description is one sentence in my own words, ending with a period —
      not the project's own marketing copy
- [ ] Entry added to **both** `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md`
      (if you can't write the Chinese, say so and it will be added on merge)
- [ ] Tagged `(Paid)` if paid or freemium; `(Official)` / `(Chinese)` as applicable.
      Tags match in both files
- [ ] Em dash ` — ` between the link and the description, not a hyphen
- [ ] Ran `./scripts/check-links.sh` and pasted the real output below
